hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Polished UI chrome (soft palette, clean card, good typographic hierarchy) but the main visualization overflows its container — circles are clipped at the bottom — and the edge bundles render as a dense tangle of dark lines that obscures rather than reveals the hierarchical connections.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout node sizing, scale domains derived from data via d3.extent, and key functions present on node and edge-bundle link selections; minor gap is hierarchyLinkSelection joining without a key function, risking element identity issues on re-render.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing param range sliders fire `updateLayout()` (full 1500ms transition) on every `input` event without debounce; no `.interrupt()` before new transitions causes mid-flight conflicts especially when switching to force layout while shape-morph is in flight; `mouseover`/`click` handlers lack touch-event filtering.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: 200 nodes and 300 bundled edges rendered in a circle-pack layout produce a dense hairball where edge bundles obscure node structure and the 10-color Tableau palette can't be distinguished through the overlapping strokes.
